decision: Rejected: all four prevalidated-read-cache variants regress bounded rtts Windows 95 startup; production code restored. First variant improves larger memory working sets but regresses small paged cases.
ramSweepVariant: helper-fill only; later variants were not rerun on the RAM sweep

ramSweep.scope: Three alternating headless CPU-only RAM sweep pairs, existing paged read guards versus a prevalidated host read cache. Same program, result, instruction counts. One host, no confidence intervals.

baseline.scope:
Original dependent-load sweep, not an lmbench port or official lmbench score.

Same guest COM for a CPU/JIT-only PCEMU harness and QEMU's full PC TCG.
Supervisor flat/identity-paged 4KiB RAM, no measured disk activity. QEMU uses
host socket-receipt timing; PCEMU timestamps in its port handler. Reported
ns/load includes guest execution, guards and dispatch, not raw host DRAM latency.

helper-fill.scope: Five alternating headless rtts Win95 startup prefixes, stop at 300M instructions, host network disconnected, no frame capture or UI control. Guest/device fields and total instruction count match; implementation JIT counters, disk path and host timing may differ; not bytewise RAM equality or Explorer readiness/timing.
